thread:
sara: quick check — finalizing the release notes for the small hotfix we want to push tomorrow 09:00 PST. thinking to trim the public RN to 2 bullets and keep the internal note expanded. opinions? :thought_balloon:
raj: i prefer 2 bullets public + link to detailed doc. keeps CS noise down. agree on expanding internal.
maria: note on ops side — our change window is only 09:00–09:30; anything longer and we risk overlapping backups. can we keep deploy to <5m?
sara: yes that's the ask. it's a config toggle + rollout pin only. plan: pin to v1.12.3-hotfix, canary 2m, full at 5m if health ok.
tim: thumbs up. what are rollback criteria?
jen: failures: 5xx > 1% for 2 consecutive minutes OR error spike on latency p95 > 200ms. rollback command is `deploybot rollback v1.12.2`.
raj: confirm deploybot cues — can we have an audible and a channel ping on canary fail? also want auto-fallback to the dedicated tier if GPU OOMs.
deploybot: deploy queued by sara for tag v1.12.3-hotfix -> starting canary at 2026-04-02T16:00:00Z (simulated). will post status updates here.
maria: ops checklist for the window:
```
- DB read replicas set to low-traffic
- disable noncritical background jobs
- enable verbose logging on inference service
- healthcheck config: /healthz?quick=true
```
jen: adding to RN draft: internal note includes rollback triggers + ops checklist + pin instructions. public RN: 2 bullets: "fixes timeout edge case in batching" and "reduces token memory growth".
sara: ok drafting now. pinging @all-release to review in 30m. can someone confirm legal ok with the short public blurb?
raj: legal gave verbal ok last week for hotfix wording, no new PII exposure so good. :thumbsup:
maria: once canary goes live, i'll monitor metrics and post a short snapshot. if anything abnormal i will trigger rollback and annotate reasons.
deploybot: canary started — 1 of 5 instances, traffic 10%. health checks passing.
tim: quick note on pinning: ensure client SDKs use model pin `v1.12.3-hotfix` or we might see mixing. i'll add a brief snippet to release note.
sara: perfect. final ask: keep public RN publish delayed until 09:20 PST to ensure we have metrics for the first 20 minutes. internal note goes out immediately.
jen: copy that. i'll send internal announce now and queue public for 09:20.
maria: monitoring — all green so far. will update at +10m and +20m.
deploybot: canary 2m report: 0 errors, p95 latency steady. advancing to 50% at 2026-04-02T16:03:00Z.
sara: thanks team. if nothing pops by 09:25 PST we finalize public RN and flip the publish toggle. :rocket:
